Superintelligence refers to AI that would outperform humans across nearly all cognitive tasks. It does not exist yet, but AI capabilities are advancing quickly.

items.question: Can you build a superintelligent AI for my business?

children.text: No one can today. We help you adopt the most capable AI available now, such as
AI agents
, while building the foundations to adapt as AI advances.

items.question: How do you keep advanced AI safe?

children.text: We use permissions, human approval for high-risk actions, audit logs, and continuous testing.

items.question: Which AI models do you work with?

children.text: We are model-agnostic and work with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and others, choosing based on accuracy, cost, and privacy.

items.question: How long does an AI readiness assessment take?

children.text: Most assessments take two to four weeks, depending on the size of your organization.
